schemaVersion: Ehel Stage 2 Art & Design Placement Exam v1.0
subject: Art & Design
title: Stage 2 Art & Design Starting Check
description: A short, friendly check of what you learned in Grade 1 - lines and tools, colours and patterns, making and looking - so we know where to start and which Grade 1 lessons to look at again.
attemptsAllowed: Unlimited - this check finds your starting point; it is never a fail
feedbackMode: Immediate child-friendly feedback with a starting-point report
_comment: Grade 1's content, asked the Grade 1 way: `pic` and `optionPics` are optional pictures for a young reader (an emoji, `mark:<kind>` for a line drawn by the lesson kit, or `swatch:<hex>`). Review lessons are Grade 1's, and the page links them in ../grade-1-v2/. Built into starting-check.html by ../lesson-kit/build-check.py and checked by ../lesson-kit/check-coverage.py.

ready.label: Ready for Stage 2
ready.message: Brilliant! You remember your lines, colours and patterns like a real artist. Start with Lesson 1 and enjoy Grade 2.

readyWithReview.label: Ready, with a quick look back
readyWithReview.message: You are ready to start Grade 2. Look again at the Grade 1 lessons below first, with a grown-up close by.

notReady.label: Let's look back at Grade 1 first
notReady.message: Let's go back to Grade 1 for a little while. Do the lessons below with a grown-up, then come and try again.

recommendation.label: Grade 1 Art & Design, Lesson 1 with a grown-up

sections.title: Lines, tools and textures
sections.description: Do you remember the kinds of line, which tool makes which mark, and how things feel?

sections.title: Colours, shapes and patterns
sections.description: Can you say what two colours make, find a shape, and continue a pattern?

sections.title: Making and looking
sections.description: Do you remember how to join things, use scissors safely, and look at art and say something kind?

questions.question: Which line turns sharply, like lightning?
questions.options: a wavy line | a zigzag | a straight line
questions.explanation: A zigzag turns sharply, up and down, like lightning. A wavy line is gentle.

questions.question: Which tool makes a wide, wet line?
questions.explanation: A brush is wide and wet. A pencil makes a thin, dry line.

questions.question: Which one feels smooth?
questions.explanation: Your finger slides on a mirror. Bark and sandpaper are rough.

questions.question: What does water do to paint?
questions.options: makes it runny | makes it thick | makes it bumpy
questions.explanation: Water thins paint until it runs. Flour makes it thick, and rice makes it bumpy.

questions.question: Red and white make…
questions.explanation: White makes red lighter. Light red is pink.

questions.question: Yellow, yellow, green, yellow, yellow. What comes next?
questions.explanation: Yellow, yellow, green, and then it starts again: yellow, yellow, green.

questions.question: Which shape has three straight sides?
questions.options: a circle | a square | a triangle
questions.explanation: A triangle has three straight sides and three corners.

questions.question: Which join lets a card wheel turn round?
questions.options: glue | a split pin | sticky tape
questions.explanation: A split pin goes through both pieces and lets them turn. Glue and tape hold them still.

questions.question: How should you use scissors?
questions.options: walk about with them | sit down and cut carefully | wave them in the air
questions.explanation: Sit down, hold them steady, and cut carefully, with a grown-up close by.

questions.question: Which of these is woven, over and under?
questions.options: a clay pot | a basket | a painting
questions.explanation: A basket is woven, over and under. A pot is clay and a painting is paint.

questions.question: Your friend painted a big yellow sun. Which is a kind and true thing to say?
questions.options: I like your boat. | Your yellow sun is so bright. | That is bad.
questions.correctAnswer: Your yellow sun is so bright.
questions.explanation: Name something that is really in the picture. There is a sun, and no boat.
